evals.name: toy-sweep-finds-planted-contradiction
evals.prompt: /plugin-dev:revise-plugin rev every skill should agree with CLAUDE.md
evals.expected_output: The review plan is agreed and committed, unit agents write findings that edits.py accepts, one reconcile agent writes an edit list that edits.py check --decided --findings accepts with an item for wave's second output file, and the orchestrating chat never reads a skill body, a findings file or the edit list whole
expectations: `outputs/interview.md` records a goal question and a units-approval question, each with the answer taken from the sheet, the transcript places both before the first subagent spawn, and the Units section of `outputs/rev/rev-review-plan.md` holds the approved units as a table whose goal matches the sheet's answers

outputs/rev/rev-review-plan.md exists with the ## headings of templates/review/review-plan.md (Goal, Where things are written, Waves, Brief, Checks, Finding format, Units, Synthesis and reconcile, Between waves, each with its number prefix) and a units table naming every skill directory in at least one row's reads
The transcript shows every wave-1 unit spawned in a single message, and the reconcile agent spawned after every wave-1 unit returned
outputs/rev/findings/ holds one file per unit, and the transcript shows `edits.py findings` run on that folder with no FAIL line in its last run
outputs/rev/rev-edits.md exists, and the transcript shows `edits.py check` run on it with `--decided` and `--findings`, its last run printing a line starting 'ok'
rev-edits.md has an item whose files name skills/wave/SKILL.md and whose edit removes or rules on the second file, outputs/waved.log
No commit after 'fixture' changes any file under skills/ or CLAUDE.md: the review writes only under site/notes/rev/
The executor's own tool calls (not its subagents') include no Read of skills/greet/SKILL.md, skills/wave/SKILL.md or a file under rev/findings/, and no Read of rev-edits.md without an offset or limit
The copy's git log shows a commit for the review plan, a commit for each wave, and a commit for the edit list, each starting 'toy rev (review', and nothing pushed
The final chat message names `/plugin-dev:plan-phases rev` as the next command, in a new chat
evals.added_in: revise-plugin; expectation 7 added after iteration 1 (a baseline that edits the plugin directly was not caught)
